user_query: I'm writing a research paper on climate change and I need some statistics and data to support my arguments. Can you provide me with relevant articles and research papers on climate change? Additionally, show me images related to climate change to enhance the visual impact of my paper.

TaskList.description: Search for relevant articles and research papers on climate change.
Gather statistics and data from the selected articles and research papers.
Search for and retrieve images related to climate change.
Compile and organize the collected articles, statistics, and images for the research paper.
